parameters.query: DELETE FROM jc_mail WHERE received_at < now() - interval '90 days' RETURNING id;

SELECT id, account, to_addr, from_name, from_addr, subject, summary, category FROM jc_mail WHERE digested_at IS NULL AND notified_at IS NULL AND category IN ('normal', 'promo', 'pending') AND received_at > now() - interval '3 days' ORDER BY id;
UPDATE jc_mail SET digested_at = now() WHERE id = ANY($1::bigint[]) RETURNING id;
